Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this — MedCord is ready to start portal onboarding but legal has redlined the MSA and we have a couple of integration asks that may affect our Ariba/Coupa setup:

- We're proposing a narrow tax-withholding carveout (see attached MedCord_MSA_Redline_v1.pdf). In AP our bank requires a PO prefix to route invoices to our remittance engine; can Redwood preserve a PO prefix field for EDI mapping?

Can you loop in legal and procurement on your side and confirm who will own the Ariba supplier ID mapping and where we should upload signed docs? We can also jump on a 30m call if easier.

Elena / Tessa — I reviewed the redline. High level: we can accommodate most items but need narrow, contractually precise language for tax withholding and data residency. Suggested edits below (prefer track changes in a single document so we can sign quickly):

1) Tax withholding (proposed replacement clause):
"Each party shall be responsible for its own tax obligations. Notwithstanding the foregoing, if Redwood is legally required by applicable law to withhold taxes on payments to Supplier, Redwood shall provide Supplier prompt written notice and remit withheld amounts to the relevant authority; Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to cooperate with Supplier to obtain any available tax credits or refunds."

2) Order Form / PO prefix & EDI ack window: operationally we can preserve a PO prefix metadata field in Ariba/Coupa and set the initial EDI ack window to 48 hours during a 30-day stabilization period. We will encode the stabilization period into the onboarding checklist rather than the MSA.

3) Data residency: we are amenable to a limited data residency representation for the Order Form ("Customer data shall be stored and processed in the United States") — please confirm the exact jurisdiction language you require.

Attachments: MSA_redline_comments.docx (inline explanations).

If you can consolidate the redline and send one marked-up MSA (preferred DocuSign envelope), Legal can sign off conditional on the final Order Form amendment. Tessa / Kimberly: please confirm the internal owning team for Ariba field mapping and whether we need a separate SOW for the EDI mapping effort.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Associate General Counsel | Redwood Inference
